name: Default — Bo5
author: sunguraa
description: A coin flip decides who starts. Teams ban one map, pick four maps, then ban two more. The other team picks the side for each picked map. The team that did not ban last picks the side for the final map.
notes: Port Euler excluded from Season 3 ranked pool. 3 bans + 4 picks = 7 maps touched, 1 decider.
